steps.read: 看 3.1 三类方程的定解问题与 3.2 判别式／标准形，先分清椭圆、抛物、双曲。
看第 4–6 章 D'Alembert 公式、适定性、Sturm–Liouville 与分离变数，练波动／热／位势方程的边值问题。
看第 7–8 章 Fourier 变换解法、能量方法唯一性与极值原理。
进阶：读 §58–§76 的分布、基本解、Sobolev 空间与弱解，把适定性提升到弱解层次。
Work through 18.303's heat, wave and Poisson equations, boundary conditions, eigenproblems, separation of variables and Green's functions.
Do the finite difference/finite element and stability/convergence part for the numerical side.
For weak solutions and well-posedness, read Hunter's Sobolev/weak-solution chapters; use them to justify existence, uniqueness and continuous dependence.
